Resolves #4528

Updates `Docs.view.classdetails.HierarchyTreeList#createStoreItems` (`docs/app/view/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.mjs`) so only the selected class (`key.neoClassName === className`) starts with `checked: true` while ancestor classes default to `checked: false`. Adds `Docs.view.classdetails.HierarchyTreeList#createItem` to append the `'unchecked'` CSS class when `!record.checked` so initial checkbox icons match `record.checked` and `onLeafItemClick` toggling.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit test in `test/playwright/unit/apps/docs/view/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (unit verification of initial `HierarchyTreeList` checked state, `'unchecked'` VDOM class rendering, `MembersList` filtering, and ancestor toggle).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/apps/docs/view/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.spec.mjs` (`checks only the selected class by default, renders ancestors with unchecked cls, and filters MembersList to the selected class until an ancestor is toggled`) |

## Deltas from ticket
Added `HierarchyTreeList#createItem(record)` override so initial VDOM list items for unchecked ancestors carry the `'unchecked'` CSS class expected by `resources/scss/src/apps/docs/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.scss` and `onLeafItemClick`.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-03T05:39:59Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — a default and a render hook inside the docs app's class-details view, with no engine or consumed surface touched.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** #4528 (2023) asks the docs to open on the selected class's own members, and `docs/` is the only API surface with a hierarchy list, so this is its owner. `createStoreItems` now checks only `key.neoClassName === className`. The `createItem` override adds `unchecked` for an unchecked record, and that is required: `onLeafItemClick` toggles the cls from the record's current state, and `.neo-list-item.unchecked` is what swaps the icon from `\f14a` to `\f0c8` in `HierarchyTreeList.scss`. `createItem` is the real `Neo.tree.List` hook, also used when an item re-renders (`src/tree/List.mjs:778`), so the icon stays consistent. `MembersList.filterAndSortItems` already shows only `checked === true` classes, so the members and the section counts follow the new default.

Verified at exact head `79f63a2a46`: the spec passes, and with the `unchecked` branch disabled it fails (`unchecked` missing from `["neo-list-item", "neo-list-item-leaf"]`), so its render arm discriminates. CI is green (39, 1 skipped). I looked for member deep links that would now land on a hidden ancestor and found none: the only `scrollIntoView` (`MainContainerController#onScrollIntoView`) scrolls to section headers.

**Findings:** None.
